main_text.l: rum nervum easdem non esse, ostensum est; nisi crassæ alicujus oblivionis in politiæ suæ Judaicæ legibus, & imperfectionis in judiciorum illius constitutione insimulare Deum velimus.

Deinde ethnicum tormentorum horum, & tyrannicum est inventum, omnis charitatis & commiserationis, quæ sontibus etiam & reis suo modo debetur, nedum illis, quos sontes esse nondum exploratum habemus, expers. Non, quòd nihil prorsus ab ethnicis usurpatum, usurpare liceat Christianis: sed quòd legi etiam naturæ repugnare censeatur, quos sontes nondum novimus, tam diris subjicere cruciatibus, qui morti æquiparantur, & veritatem per exquisitissimum illud genus pœnæ inquirere: quodque adeò hæc inquisitionis ratio Christianis merito suspecta, imò exosa esse debeat. Josephus enim libro de imperio rationis, seu Macchabæis, author est, Antiochum Epiphanem, qui hinc etiam Epi-manis cognomen in ecclesia fortitus est, pium Macchabæum jussisse in medium protrahi, & sacrilegis carnificum manibus distendi atrociùs, qui etiam manus illi post tergum ligârint, cru-deliùs verberârint, mole pedibus appensâ illigârint, rotæ innexuerint, & in gyrum circuli por-rexerint, ut solutis hinc inde visceribus, venisque distentis, dolores ipsius & venæ crescerent. Po-lydorus Virgilius lib.2. de invent.cap.3. hoc tor-mentorum genus Romanis adscribit, addens in-super: Cùm instrumenta hæc sola sint, quibus tyranni imprimis ad suam tuendam dominationem utuntur, eo-rum inventione Nimroth, primo tyranno, rectè assigna-[?]

page.notes: The left strip of the scan shows the edge of the neighbouring page and was left out. The margin note "2." and "Ethnicum & tyrannicum inventum sunt." was joined from its hyphenated line ends. The last word of the page is cut off at the foot of the scan: "assigna-" is probably "assignatum" but is not legible, so it is marked [?]. Long s was written as plain s throughout, including "ostensum" and "esse", which the printer set with a long-s form.
